provenance.title: How to PROPERLY Dumbbell Row | 3 Dumbbell Row Variations for Muscle Gain
provenance.creator: Colossus Fitness
provenance.license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (YouTube Creative Commons Attribution license)
provenance.excerpt: 19.7–27.8 s of original video. Cropped and muted.

cases.note: Actual one-arm bench-supported dumbbell rows. The working shoulder and ribcage repeatedly roll up and outward during the pull and return on the way down, with the supporting hand planted. Grade manually for keeping the chest more square to the floor and avoiding substantial torso twist. Do not infer spinal loading, far shoulder angle, or shortened bottom range; the weight sometimes goes beyond the bottom of frame.
